description: It’s an honor to be re-elected as Colorado State House Majority Leader. I will continue to work tirelessly for the people of Colorado. I will continue to elevate and unite us and strive to create an environment where diversity in opinions and personalities is respected. I’m proud of our diverse leadership team and caucus, and I look forward to working with my caucus to advance our agenda and our Democratic values.
